description: After burning the residents of Bloody Blink’s city thanks to his brother in arms Pig Bull, Coal Cauldron distributed the city’s Techs to his allies... after helping himself. Now Warlord of the region with his friend Pig Bull, he rules with an iron wheel, undefeated by the survivors under his yoke.
summon: I will roll over the ashes of our enemies!
evolution: Thanks to Techs, my flames are more powerful than ever.
